traits.name: Camouflaged Step
traits.text: The skulk gains the benefit of the Cover Tracks action in forests and subterranean settings without moving at half Speed.

traits.name: Chameleon Skin
traits.text: The skulk's skin shifts and changes to match the surroundings. As long as most of their body is not covered by clothing or armor, the skulk gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to Hide.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: A skulk's Strikes deal an extra 1d6 (1d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ shortsword +8 (agile, finesse, versatile s); Damage 1d6+2 (1d6+2) piercing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ dagger +8 (agile, thrown 10 feet, versatile s); Damage 1d4+2 (1d4+2) piercing
